parsed.rationale: Although both records carry all context flags as false, the file path for MockDeviceContext — 'Shared/Wallpaper/Tests/WallpaperTests/Mocks/MockDeviceContext.swift' — places it unambiguously inside a Tests directory under a Mocks subdirectory. This is the canonical test-fixture pattern: a mock type that mirrors the shape of a production protocol (DeviceContextProtocol in 'Shared/Wallpaper/Sources/Wallpaper/Throttling/DeviceContext.swift') so that tests can substitute it.
